hints.title: Constant Time Eviction and Lookup
hints.text: How can you look up values by key in constant time while also tracking the order of usage for constant-time eviction?

hints.title: Dual Structure Composition
hints.text: A key lookup collection provides constant-time access, and a doubly linked node chain provides constant-time node removal and front insertion.

hints.title: Sentinel Doubly Linked Cache Procedure
hints.text: Maintain key-to-node mapping and a doubly linked chain with dummy head and tail sentinels. On get, if present, move the node to front and return its value; else -1. On put, update existing node and move to front; else create node, insert at front, and if capacity exceeded, remove node before tail and delete its key.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Node:
    def __init__(self, key=0, val=0):
        self.key = key
        self.val = val
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class LRUCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.cap = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = Node()
        self.tail = Node()
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node) -> None:
        p = node.prev
        n = node.next
        p.next = n
        n.prev = p

    def _add_to_front(self, node: Node) -> None:
        node.next = self.head.next
        node.prev = self.head
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add_to_front(node)
            return node.val
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            node.val = value
            self._add_to_front(node)
        else:
            if len(self.cache) >= self.cap:
                lru = self.tail.prev
                self._remove(lru)
                del self.cache[lru.key]
            new_node = Node(key, value)
            self.cache[key] = new_node
            self._add_to_front(new_node)
```

variables: operations: up to 2 * 10^5 get and put calls
complexity.notes: Both get and put run in strictly O(1) time using pointer updates in doubly linked list.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using an array or list to track timestamps requires O(N) time to find or remove elements on each access, leading to TLE on large operation sequences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Doubly linked list node pointers paired with a hash table achieve strictly O(1) time for both operations using O(capacity) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sentinel dummy head and tail nodes to avoid null-checking edge cases during node removal and insertion, clean helper functions _remove and _add_to_front, correct eviction of the least recently used key.
